inputs.prompt: A huge sand shark, a monster that swims through desert sand like water. Dusty red brown back, pale cream belly, a huge jaw full of jagged bone white teeth, a tall blade shaped dorsal fin, a ridge of spines down its back and a heavy powerful tail, each of them clearly visible. Old spear scars and broken spear shafts stuck in its hide. It bursts up out of a sand dune at a steep angle with its tail lashing behind it, its body thick and heavy and covered in rough armoured hide, short heavy bone plates down its back. Scene: the red sand wastes at dusk in a rising sandstorm, a huge low sun burning orange red through the haze behind it, two tiny hunters with spears in the foreground for scale. A still from an 80s dark fantasy film, painted like an epic fantasy matte painting. Cinematic low camera angle, dramatic rim light from behind, thick drifting fog and haze, deep black shadows, a muted teal grey palette with one glowing hot accent colour. Moody, epic and menacing, the whole creature in frame, facing left.
